body.p: Crab (bali) was mutjiŋga (very old woman). She was very sick. Everyone thought she was dead. They buried her in a hole. But she was not dead. She stayed there about five days. She made a new shell and left the old one in the ground.

Crow was there waiting. The people were crying. Yau! Crab was there! The mutjiŋga came back. Everyone was happy. Crow was angry. He said to Crab: "That way takes too long. This is what we people must do." He plucked Crab's eyes out. Then he died immediately.
